title: When the Songbook Sings
author: Theo Sterling
blurb: Marguerite Ashgrove, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
